Song.title: Song
Song.description: A Moroccan Darija song entry (1-20) with lyrics, admin_feeling, musical settings, mastering metrics, Gemini transcription quality metrics, and Cloud Storage audio reference.

feeling_key.description: Canonical feeling identifier used in filenames and songs.json.

admin_feeling.description: Admin feeling category selected from the 8 allowed categories.

title.description: Arabic script song title matching the start of line 1.

theme.description: Short English description of the human feeling.

lines.description: Moroccan Darija lyric lines in Arabic script (target: 6 lines, max 5 words per line).

tempo_bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute (70 to 100).

model_used.description: Lyria model ID used to generate the audio, or null if not generated.

status.description: Current song generation and upload status.

duration_seconds.description: Mastered WAV duration in seconds, or null.

lufs.description: Measured integrated loudness in LUFS, or null.

true_peak_db.description: Measured true peak in dBTP, or null.

storage_path.description: Cloud Storage object path (songs/<file_name>), or null.

download_url.description: Cloud Storage download URL for playback and export, or null.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the mastered WAV was uploaded and marked ready.

error_message.description: Error detail if generation or upload failed, or null.

words_heard_pct.description: Percentage (0-100) of expected lyric words heard in order in Gemini's transcription.

transcribed_text.description: Sung Arabic words transcribed by Gemini.

missing_words.description: Expected lyric words not matched in order.

extra_words.description: Extra transcribed words not matched in order.

voice_start_seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds when the singing voice begins.

voice_end_seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds when the singing voice ends.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator/owner.

/songs/{songId}.description: Collection of the 20 Moroccan Darija family songs, keyed by song number (1 through 20).
